title: Transcript extraction result
description: Contract between the Claude routine and drainOutbox() in apps-script/Code.gs. The routine writes one of these to the Drive Outbox folder as tasks-<fileId>.json; the Apps Script reads it and creates the Google Tasks. Bump `version` in both places together if this shape changes.

version.description: Schema version. Must match OUTBOX_SCHEMA_VERSION in Code.gs, or the file is quarantined in Failed/ rather than processed against a shape the script doesn't understand.

sourceFileId.description: Drive file ID of the transcript, from the fire payload.

processedAt.description: When the routine produced this result.

isTranscript.description: False when the file turned out not to be a meeting transcript. The Apps Script still needs the file to distinguish 'nothing to do' from 'the run failed'.

skipReason.description: One-line explanation when isTranscript is false; null otherwise.

title.description: Actionable imperative phrase, under ~80 characters. Becomes the Google Task title.

owner.description: Person responsible, as named in the transcript. Google Tasks has no assignee field, so this is written into the task notes as 'Owner: <name>'. Omitted when unclear.

due.description: Deadline as YYYY-MM-DD, only when one was actually stated. Google Tasks stores the date and discards any time component, so this is a due DATE, never a due time.

notes.description: One or two sentences of context, merged into the task notes.

sourceQuote.description: Short verbatim phrase the item came from, so the task can be traced back to the transcript.

drafts.description: Gmail drafts the routine created. Informational only — the Apps Script logs the count and takes no action, since the drafts already exist in Gmail by the time this file is written.
